notes.notes:
[b]LIVE NOW - October 31st 2024 - Full release v1.0[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225604/1e973755f9106ad9de2dbdd31c29f544b1a6a70b.png[/img]

[code]Well, what can I say, "I FINALLY MADE IT", I have no idea how I got here. It's been a long hard slog, and although it's not over just yet, I've finally reached a substantial milestone. I would like to thank everyone who has clicked through to this game, and especially those who have offered feedback. Massive thank you to those who have wish listed this bundle. Hope you can find it in your heart to support me into the future. 

I foolishly decided to create three love letters to retro gaming. While I learned the ins and outs of game development. Thou I am far from perfect in the field. I have tried my very best to achieve a fairly playable game. I can put my hand on my heart and say I have, a much greater respect to all of those in the industry of game development, all aspects are difficult. So those skilled in their field, deserve at least some.

I know as gamers we don't really care about the journey or the struggles of the game dev. We only care about the end result. [/code]

Having said that.
